latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—introduces TDD and Programming by Difference for safe feature addition to tested legacy code.

- Supports adding features via Test-Driven Development (TDD) or Programming by Difference (PbD), with guidance on when to use each.
- Details step-by-step processes for confirming test coverage, choosing an approach, and executing safely.
- Includes triggers, prerequisites, and exclusions to guide correct usage.
- Integrates with related skills for legacy code change and test introduction.
- Designed for intermediate software engineers working in an environment with an established test suite.
